actions.action: Review 1 unanswered low-rated reviews in the examined data and prepare a professional response for approval.
actions.basis: stars<=2 AND reply_present=false; no inference about medical care.

actions.action: Complete the review source and reply statuses before reporting an overall rate.
actions.basis: A sample or unknown state does not establish full coverage.

reply_drafts.text: Thank you for your feedback. We are sorry you were dissatisfied. Please contact management through its official channels so the concern can be reviewed while protecting privacy.
Thank you for your review. We appreciate your feedback and interest.

limits: Synthetic demonstration data only; not a real business.
Calculations describe examined data; do not generalize a sample to all reviews.
Field presence does not prove correctness; presence percentage is an internal six-field definition, not a score from Google.
Feedback themes are predefined inputs, not verified AI analysis.
Overall score, review quality and visual presence are not calculated because no accepted standard exists.
No sending, publishing or access to Google or n8n; a data adapter and independent approval are required before integration.
